technique_name: Write a short essay on the importance of understanding one's cultural identity.
description: Having an understanding of one’s cultural identity is paramount in forming a sense of self-worth, community and self-discovery. It is important to recognize the vast array of cultural influences that one is exposed to, or that make up the collective experiences of their ancestors. Culture helps individuals to make sense of our lives, and define how we look at the world. It is crucial to develop a strong sense of cultural identity, in large part due to the impacts of colonization and assimilation
